method: Scope gate: domain terms + TF-IDF logistic regression (supported vs other CFPB products)

fine_tuned_153_with_gate.note: Gated cases count as errors here; in the app they go to human review.

limitations: Unrelated examples are a small authored challenge set (108 texts), not a real traffic sample.
Other-product complaints come from the same 2011-2018 CFPB archive as the training data.
Debt collection complaints often discuss credit reports, so many still pass the gate.
Supported complaints that are sent to review are not lost; a reviewer classifies them.
